problem.historical_gap: Stage21 retained exact source_view identity but Stage23 collapsed runtime provenance to coarse provenance class only, so two OTHER_VIEW_SOURCE texels from different donor views became indistinguishable after bake/package.
problem.false_pass_risk: Same coarse provenance could hide a donor-view switch seam or destroy provenance lineage even while RGB/native parity stayed green.

shipping_contract.runtime_package: provenance.bin stores coarse provenance u8 followed by exact source_view int16 for the same VxHxW atlas.

fail_closed_chain: Stage23 bakes source_view with the exact face-lattice/bleed mapping used by RGBA/provenance.
Stage37 rejects missing, malformed, invalid-valued, or padding-inconsistent source_view lineage.
RSS V2 requires provenance and source_view arrays with exact matching shape and padding semantics.
Native V2 parses and validates source_view lineage and refuses any manifest that promotes donor identity to render authority.

adversarial_proof.same_coarse_provenance_different_donors: V0 synthetic atlas uses coarse OTHER_VIEW_SOURCE everywhere while left/right texels carry donor views 1 and 2; bilinear footprint must report NEG3_MIXED.
adversarial_proof.non_authority: Rewriting all V0 donor identities to donor 7 must alter only the donor diagnostic bytes; RGBA, coarse provenance, and owner bytes must remain byte-identical.

claim_boundary: Source-view lineage is preserved for provenance/audit/debug evidence. It does not become an alternate appearance, geometry, visibility, or presentation authority.
